lgd_definition: “Livestock Guardian Dogs” shall be defined as a dog that works and/or lives with domestic farm animals, in a bona fide farming operation, to protect them
herding_definition: “Herding Dog” shall mean a dog that has been trained and is actively being used in a bona fide farming operation for the purposes of controlling livestock on the farm.
collar_tag_req: Dogs must wear a collar and tag, provided that the owner uses an alternative means of identification, the by-law explicitly exempts livestock guardian dog(s) and herding dog(s) being actively used in farming practices from the requirement to wear a collar and tag.
dog_limit: Maximum of 3 dogs per premises in residential areas. Persons are allowed to keep more than three dogs at a premise without obtaining a kennel license, providing they meet certain agricultural criteria.
notes: URL: https://www.antownship.ca/media/mwcbz0y0/2022-0048.pdf. Very farm-friendly bylaw. Exempts LGDs and herding dogs from annual licensing fees, collar/tag requirements, and barking restrictions if actively engaged in guarding livestock against predators.

collar_tag_req: Upon payment of the license fee the owner of the dog shall be supplied with a dog tag. The said tag shall be kept securely affixed to the dog in which it was assigned at all times.
dog_limit: No person shall own or keep four (4) or more than four dogs without obtaining a Kennel License.
notes: URL: https://www.assiginack.ca/media/45. Standard animal control bylaw. No exemptions for LGDs or farm dogs.

lgd_definition: "Livestock Guardian Dog" means a dog that works and/or lives with Livestock to protect them while repelling predators and is used exclusively for that purpose;
herding_definition: "Herding Dog" means a dog that has been trained and is actively being used in a bona fide farming operation for the purpose of controlling Livestock on a farm;
collar_tag_req: All dogs must be licensed. Failure to keep a tag on a licensed dog is a finable offence.
dog_limit: Keeping more than three (3) dogs requires a Kennel Licence.
notes: URL: https://www.arran-elderslie.ca/media/tn0h2x3y/by-law-29-2024-animal-control-by-law.pdf. Contains specific definitions for Livestock Guardian Dogs and Herding Dogs. The municipality's fee bylaw (67-2024) specifies that Working Dogs are exempt from licensing fees.

collar_tag_req: Every owner must securely affix on the collar of the dog, the dog tag issued by the Town or its representatives.
dog_limit: General limits apply per household/zoning. The town is working on adopting a new consolidated Animal Services By-law in 2025.
notes: URL: https://records.aurora.ca/WebLink/DocView.aspx?id=17725&dbid=0&repo=Public. Standard urban animal control bylaw. Service dogs have fees waived, but there are no definitions or exemptions for working/farm dogs.

BYLAW NOT FOUND. Baldwin lists '2017-A-06-Animal-Control' on its website but the PDF is not publicly available. Animal control is outsourced to Rainbow District Animal Services. Noise By-law 2023-003 exists and exempts Normal Farm Practices, but specific dog bylaw details could not be extracted.

lgd_definition: Livestock Guardian Dog shall mean a Dog that is specifically recognized and used to work and/or live with domestic farm animals, without causing them harm while aggressively repelling predators and is used exclusively for that purpose;
collar_tag_req: Every Owner shall affix to the Dog's collar or restraining device, a current Dog Tag. Livestock Guardian Dogs are exempt from this requirement if registered with the Township using a verified microchip.
dog_limit: No Owner shall keep, or permit to be kept, more than three (3) Dogs over the age of ninety days on any premises at any one time (does not apply to licensed kennels).
notes: URL: https://adjtos.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/By-law-2024-063-Canine-Control-By-law.pdf. Very farm-friendly bylaw. LGDs are exempt from license fees and collar/tag requirements if microchipped. Additionally, acting in its function as a Livestock Guardian Dog is listed as a 'Mitigating Factor' for aggressive behavior.

collar_tag_req: Every Owner of a Dog or Cat shall ensure the identification tag is displayed on the dog or cats collar, and that the collar is affixed while off the Owner's Premises.
dog_limit: No Person shall keep more than four (4) Dogs or more than four (4) Cats, provided the combined maximum shall not exceed four (4). This restriction does not apply where the Premises consists of lands zoned and used for agricultural purposes.
notes: URL: https://www.blindriver.ca/media/dkqerdbn/animal-regulation-bylaw.pdf. While it does not specifically define working dogs, the animal control bylaw explicitly exempts properties zoned and used for agricultural purposes from the municipal dog limits.

collar_tag_req: Unless a dog is being lawfully used for hunting in the bush, it shall constitute an offence for any owner to fail to keep a dog tag securely fixed on the dog at all times.
dog_limit: It shall constitute an offence for any person to harbour more than a total of three (3) dogs in or about any single dwelling unit.
notes: URL: https://www.belleville.ca/files/Belleville_Dog_By-Law_2005-206_Consolidated_May_2014.pdf. Standard animal control bylaw with no exemptions for farm dogs or LGDs.

collar_tag_req: Every owner of a dog shall be furnished with a dog tag that the owner shall keep securely affixed on the dog at all times except when the dog is being lawfully used for hunting in the bush.
dog_limit: No person shall keep, or do anything which may cause to be kept, more that three (3) dogs in the Municipality, special exception license for dog teams, etc. upon application to be approved by Council.
notes: URL: https://athenstownship.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/Dog-Bylaw.pdf. Standard bylaw from the Yonge and Escott Transition Board. No specific LGD provisions.

dog_limit: Dog Owners shall only have 3 Dogs per single dwelling unit. Any Dog Owner who possesses more than three Dogs for the purpose of work or sport shall notify the Township of the number of Dogs that they are keeping as well the breeds.
notes: URL: https://www.billingstwp.ca/media/0vqd0sdd/2020-24-dog.pdf. Defines 'Working Dog' (although with non-standard breed examples) and allows owners to exceed the 3 dog limit without a kennel license if the dogs are used for work or sport, provided they notify the Township.
